overall_assessment: The codebase shows significant duplication debt concentrated in three areas: web UI auto-configuration classes (10+ classes repeating the same AbstractWebUIAutoConfiguration pattern), gateway filter logic duplicated between WebFlux and WebMVC implementations, and test setup code replicated across service integration tests. The most critical risk if unaddressed is the security logic divergence in GatewaySharedAuth, where username/role handling must be manually synchronized across three separate filter classes, increasing the likelihood of inconsistent security enforcement or missed vulnerability patches.
